output.population: 7447 adults aged 55 to 80 years at high cardiovascular risk without cardiovascular disease at enrollment
output.intervention: Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil or Mediterranean diet supplemented with mixed nuts
output.comparator: Control diet with advice to reduce dietary fat
output.effect: Hazard ratio 0.69 (95% CI 0.53 to 0.91) for extra-virgin olive oil and 0.72 (95% CI 0.54 to 0.95) for nuts versus control.
output.applicability_boundary: High-cardiovascular-risk primary-prevention population in Spain; corrected and republished analysis addresses protocol and randomization deviations.
